title: Queen's Reach
setup: A black rook idles far away on the h-file, believing it is out of danger. Your queen knows better.
hint: The queen moves like a bishop too. Trace the diagonal from d1 toward the h-file.
explanation:
## The Idea

From d1 the queen's diagonal runs e2, f3, g4 and lands on h5, where the black rook sits with nothing guarding it.

{{Qxh5}} crosses half the board in one move and takes the rook. It came along a diagonal, and a rook only watches straight lines.

The queen is a rook and a bishop in one. When you hunt with it, check both kinds of line.
